releases.notes:
## New features
- Active quest progress is now persisted to world data and restored after a server restart, so unfinished attempts resume instead of resetting when the server comes back up.
- The quest ledger stores compact binary snapshots for active occurrences, preserving condition state and already-recognized advancements while keeping stale entries out of the saved data.

## Improvements
- Progress is now serialized in definition order and saved with the live quest state, which keeps multi-step and timed conditions consistent across restarts without requiring session-only memory.
- Quest updates now prune obsolete progress when a quest completes, rotates out of the active daily or unique catalog, or changes behavior, keeping only valid live attempts in the world ledger.

## Bug fixes
- Fixed a restart regression that could discard partial progress for in-flight quests, and prevented the same advancement from being counted twice when saved progress was restored.
- Time-window and sequence conditions now continue to expire correctly after reload, and stale attempt data is dropped when a quest is removed or its behavior changes.


**Full changelog:** [v2.2.1...v2.3.0](https://github.com/RenardElectric/PolyQuest/compare/v2.2.1...v2.3.0)

releases.notes:
## Highlights
- Daily quests now rotate independently by difficulty on configurable schedules, with current assignments and unclaimed completions preserved across server restarts.

## New features
- Configure separate rotation intervals for easy, medium, and hard quests with `rotationHours`; intervals use local wall-clock boundaries anchored to Monday.
- Use `/polyquest reroll [difficulty] [quest_id]` to select a specific eligible quest for a daily difficulty, or reroll daily slots randomly as before.
- Add an optional `display_name` to `advancement_criterion`, `consume_items`, and `loot_item` conditions to show a custom objective label in the quest GUI and command details.
- Restrict `loot_item` conditions to drops from a matching broken block with a Minecraft block predicate, including block state, block entity NBT, components, and predicates.
- Quest lists are paginated at 15 quests per page, with clickable previous and next navigation.

## Improvements
- Completed but unclaimed quest attempts, current daily assignments, claims, and unfinished reward deliveries now survive server restarts; partial progress remains session-only.
- Players joining the server have their already-unlocked advancements reconciled with active quest objectives, including ordered multi-step conditions, without counting the same advancement repeatedly.
- Quest names in command messages and completion notices include colored hover details, and administrators can click them to inspect quests.
- Invalid quests, templates, and reward profiles are logged and skipped during reloads so valid resources still load; invalid or removed daily assignments are replaced when eligible quests are available.
- Quest template schemas now provide field descriptions, parameter-aware hints, and editor snippets for quest bodies, conditions, and rewards.

## Bug fixes
- Block loot objectives now evaluate the original broken block state and block entity, even after the block position changes.
- Rotating or rerolling a daily slot clears its attempts, unclaimed completions, claims, and unfinished reward transactions for that slot without reversing rewards already granted.


**Full changelog:** [v2.1.0...v2.2.0](https://github.com/RenardElectric/PolyQuest/compare/v2.1.0...v2.2.0)

releases.notes:
## Highlights
- Quest completion alerts now appear when a quest becomes claimable, and players receive a current summary of ready quests on reconnect.
- Quest messages now use a consistent PolyQuest-branded style with clearer advancement names and status text.

## New features
- Added "Quest completed" notifications that name the quest and point players to the Quest Giver.
- Added an unclaimed-quest summary that lists every currently ready quest and is sent when a player joins, reconnects, or completes a quest.

## Improvements
- Standardized chat text for daily quests, reset notices, and diagnostics to use the PolyQuest prefix and improved styling.
- Improved advancement condition text to show bracketed advancement IDs when missing and to use vanilla advancement names when available.

## Bug fixes
- Fixed missing or unnamed advancement conditions so they no longer render as an empty or broken title.
- Corrected ready-to-claim progress detection so completion notifications and summaries are published when a quest transitions to claimable state.

## Compatibility
- Requires PolyCore 1.2.5 (updated from 1.2.4), and the mod version is 2.1.0.


**Full changelog:** [v2.0.0...v2.1.0](https://github.com/RenardElectric/PolyQuest/compare/v2.0.0...v2.1.0)
